bots.title: Market Researcher
bots.description: Research notes from an adapted Anthropic financial-services skill pack (paper/read-only).
bots.descriptionDetail:
Not a new teammate. Apply Trading Team still yields the same four Cos seats. Only this seat gets extra research tooling.

Tools: financial-services (local Hermes skill/docs pack adapted from https://github.com/anthropics/financial-services, Apache-2.0; no Claude Cowork required), plus computer-use and browser.

Drafts and research only. Paper/read-only. Not a broker. Does not place orders, hold brokerage credentials, or give personalized investment advice.

After install: re-apply Trading Team. Read docs/airmaze/FINANCIAL-SERVICES.md. Cite operator-supplied or public filings; mark unsourced figures.

FactSet, Morningstar, S&P, and other Anthropic vendor MCPs are out of scope in this pack (optional later). OpenBB is also out of scope.
